## Fixes

- **Resolution names.** Wide, portrait and square videos now use YouTube's names. A 2:1 video's top version shows as 2160p instead of 1920p, and a Short shows as 1080p. Playlist resolution buttons and the default quality setting use the same names.
- **Playlists.** When several videos read their formats at the same moment, none of them loses part of what yt-dlp reported. Before, a Playlist video could occasionally fail to start.

## Before you update

- **Allow the keychain prompt.** After this update, macOS asks once whether Dowlio may read its saved browser pairings. Choose Always Allow. Your browsers stay paired.
